name: 爆款图换品（保版式批量替换产品）
trigger_phrases: 把这套图换成我的产品
用这个爆款的排版换我的产品
这套 listing 图帮我换成另一个产品
swap the product keep the layout

prompt_template.type: bulk product replacement across a reference image set, preserving everything except the product itself
prompt_template.subject: Replace the product in image 1 across images 2-7. Only the swapped product changes; keep everything else identical — composition, layout, background, lighting, text placement, props, camera angle, and style stay exactly as in each target image
prompt_template.preserve: the new product's shape, proportions, {color} packaging, logo, and label text come ONLY from image 1; scale it naturally to fit each scene's perspective and contact shadows
prompt_template.quality: seamless composite per image, consistent series look, no artifacts at product boundaries

single-target.description: 单图换品（image 1 产品换进 image 2 场景）

overrides.subject: Replace the product in image 2 with the product from image 1. Only the product changes; background, lighting, composition, and camera stay exactly as in image 2
overrides.preserve: product identity from image 1 only: shape, color, logo, label text

ref_roles.role: the NEW product — preserve its logo, color, shape, label text exactly
target scenes whose layout/composition/lighting must survive unchanged
